text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on modeling potential future suitable habitat for 76 tree species under climate change scenarios using the DISTRIB regression tree model. While it produces spatially explicit county-level projections across the eastern United States, its primary objective is species distribution modeling—not land use/land cover (LULC) prediction. The study explicitly models habitat suitability for individual tree species based on environmental variables (climate, soils, elevation), not changes in land cover classes (e.g., forest, cropland, urban) or land use transitions. It meets none of the core inclusion criteria related to LULC prediction: the focus is ecological/species-specific, not LULC; outputs are species importance values and suitable habitat maps, not LULC maps; and although multiple climate scenarios are used, they drive species responses, not land use change processes. The paper falls under “species-specific/ecological focus unrelated to LULC,” which is an explicit exclusion criterion.)
